_comment: Frozen evaluation protocol (Prompt 07). Freeze date 2026-10-28. Changes after this date go in research_decisions.md with a reason, never silently.
primary_metric: FPR on genuine references (lower is better), reported with Wilson 95% CI
secondary_metrics: recall on each fabricated set (higher is better)
PPV at prevalence pi via review Eq. 13 (higher is better)
bootstrap PPV at pi (check of Eq. 13)
paper-level cluster bootstrap CI of FPR (references of one paper resampled together)
paired_test: exact McNemar on genuine references; a difference counts if p < 0.05 AND |FPR gap| >= 0.02
positive_class: fabricated citation; a flag is a positive prediction

genuine_set.source: arXiv cs.CL papers submitted 2020-01-01 to 2022-11-29 (before ChatGPT release 2022-11-30)

positive_sets.neurips2025: GPTZero NeurIPS 2025 list of 100 (Ansari [2]) - availability pending; optional

openalex.use_for: DOI lookups always; title search only when no candidate has title sim >= 0.8

verifiers.V1E: review Eq. 2 existence only, tau = 0.85 on 0.7*title_lev + 0.3*author_overlap
verifiers.V1F: review Eqs. 2-5 + Eq. 9; tau_title 0.90, authors all cited surnames present, year exact, venue sim >= 0.5, locators exact
verifiers.V2: Naser 2026: 100*(0.6 Jaccard + 0.2 authors + 0.2 year); flag if < 80 (secondary < 65)
verifiers.V3: Neralla et al. 2026: 0.60 title + 0.25 authors + 0.15 journal; flag if < 80 (secondary < 60)
verifiers.V3a: ablation of V3: author veto (sa < 50 -> not verified), no title substitution for missing authors

deep_analysis: false positives by bib entry type and failed field

amendments.reason: time constraint before submission; see research_decisions.md D23-D27

changes.retrieval.fallback: unchanged (arXiv title search); arXiv ID lookups batched (up to 100 IDs per request)
changes.registries.openalex.max_searches: 900 -> 0 (D28: measured keyless budget ~100 searches/day; DOI lookups kept)
